title: Blinking LED with Pushbutton Switch
description: Learn basic digital input and output with Arduino. Read a momentary tactile pushbutton on a digital input pin and toggle an LED on digital pin 13 with software debouncing.

title: RGB LED Color Fader Using PWM
description: Create smooth color transitions with an RGB LED using Pulse Width Modulation (PWM). Control red, green, and blue brightness levels independently using analogWrite pins.

title: DHT11 Digital Temperature and Humidity Sensor
description: Measure ambient temperature and relative humidity using the DHT11 single-bus digital sensor. Read calibrated digital signals and output real-time sensor data over the Serial Monitor.

title: DS18B20 Waterproof One-Wire Temperature Probe
description: Read high-precision temperature measurements from multiple waterproof DS18B20 digital probes connected to a single OneWire data bus with 4.7k ohm pull-up resistor.

title: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Meter and Parking Sensor
description: Calculate distance to obstacles by emitting 40kHz ultrasound pulses and timing echo reflection with pulseIn. Trigger warning beeps and visual indicators as objects approach.

title: 16x2 Character LCD Display with I2C Backpack
description: Connect a standard 16x2 HD44780 liquid crystal character display using only two I2C communication wires (SDA and SCL) via PCF8574 expander with LiquidCrystal_I2C library.

title: SSD1306 0.96 inch Monochrome I2C OLED Display
description: Display graphics, bitmaps, sensor plots, and text on a 128x64 pixel OLED screen using hardware I2C with the Adafruit SSD1306 and GFX display driver libraries.

title: SG90 Micro Servo Motor Control with Potentiometer
description: Position a 9g SG90 micro servo motor between 0 and 180 degrees using the Arduino Servo library. Read analog input from a 10k potentiometer and map the values to servo angles.

title: Dual-Axis Pan and Tilt Servo Gimbal
description: Coordinate two hobby servo motors to rotate a camera or sensor module horizontally (pan) and vertically (tilt) using analog 2-axis joystick input.

title: Hardware Interrupts on Pin 2 for Rotary Encoder
description: Handle high-speed rotary encoder pulses asynchronously without polling in the main loop using attachInterrupt on external interrupt pins 2 and 3 for precise rotation tracking.

title: Non-Volatile Storage with Internal EEPROM
description: Save calibration constants, user settings, and device state to Arduino internal EEPROM memory so configuration survives power resets using EEPROM.get and EEPROM.put.

title: HC-05 Bluetooth Serial Wireless Module
description: Send commands and receive telemetry wirelessly between an Arduino Uno and an Android smartphone over UART serial using the HC-05 Bluetooth module and SoftwareSerial.

title: Bluetooth Controlled RC Robot Car
description: Drive a motorized smart robot chassis wirelessly using smartphone Bluetooth app commands (forward, backward, left, right, stop) parsed over serial protocol.

title: Two-Wheel Drive (2WD) Obstacle Avoiding Autonomous Robot
description: Build an autonomous wheeled robot using an L298N H-bridge dual motor driver and an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor mounted on a scanning servo to navigate around obstacles.

title: 4-Channel Infrared (IR) Line Tracking Robot
description: Guide a differential drive robot along black tape paths using a multi-sensor infrared reflectivity detector array and PID steering corrections.

title: Home Automation with 5V Relay and PIR Motion Detector
description: Switch 120V/240V AC appliances or DC loads automatically upon detecting human body motion using a passive infrared (PIR) motion sensor and an optically isolated 5V relay module.
